milestone.title: Verification gate hardening — auto-detect prose-as-verification + enforce runnable verification convention

intent.outcome: After this ships, mp milestone complete classifies AC verification strings robustly: prose / descriptive text with parentheses or `+ rg ...` patterns is auto-classified as Kind::Manual (not Runnable) and the gate no longer shell-executes it. The verification authoring convention is enforced at write-time via `mp milestone ac update` and `mp milestone step update` — non-runnable strings trigger a warn-with-fix-it response suggesting `manual: <prose>` prefix. M135 + M138 + any future milestone with the same pattern ship cleanly without `--force`. MP_VERIFY_NO_SHELL=1 (already shipped) becomes the default for legacy ACs that haven't been migrated.

problem.description: The mp milestone complete gate shell-executes every AC `verification` field that classifies as Kind::Runnable. Prose descriptions — e.g. `crates/raul/tests/tui_view_state.rs (grep-based test)` (M135 AC-02) or `crates/raul/tests/keybinds.rs + rg for hardcoded key legends in crates/raul/src/tui/render/` (M138 AC-05) — bubble up to sh: `syntax error near unexpected token`. The gate can't tell prose from a real command because both are strings, and the only escape hatches today are (a) prefix with `manual: `, or (b) set MP_VERIFY_NO_SHELL=1 (shipped by M107). Both M135 and M138 had to use `--force` to ship, and Entry 21/22 in mp-dogfood-log.md document the recurrence across milestones. The structural fix is two-part: (1) improve classify_with to detect prose patterns (parentheses, `+ rg`, `+ grep` mid-string, multi-clause sentences) and auto-route to Kind::Manual, and (2) enforce the `manual: ` prefix at write-time via mp milestone ac/step update so the convention becomes structural, not author-dependent.

in_scope: Prose detection in classify_with (crates/mp/src/ac_verify.rs:87): extend the heuristic so a verification string containing any of [ `(.*)` outside a recognised command form, `\+ rg `, `\+ grep `, `\+ find `, `\+ awk `, `\+ sed `, `; ` separating distinct clauses, two-or-more `and` conjunctions ] auto-classifies as Kind::Manual. The detection runs BEFORE the existing manual-prefix check (lower precedence), so a `manual: ` prefix still wins. Add unit tests in crates/mp/src/ac_verify.rs covering each pattern with positive (prose → Manual) and negative (legitimate commands with parentheses → Runnable) cases.

Write-time enforcement: in mp milestone ac update and mp milestone step update (crates/mp/src/commands/milestone.rs), when the new --verification / --tests value classifies as Manual via the new prose detector AND the existing value did NOT start with `manual: `, emit a structured warn: `non-runnable verification string — auto-prefix with 'manual: '? (y/n)`. In `--yes` / scripted mode, the warning is informational (no prompt); in interactive mode, the user confirms. The command succeeds either way; this is a hygiene nudge, not a hard gate.

Backfill: for every milestone on disk whose AC verification field is non-runnable prose (per the new classifier), add the `manual: ` prefix via a one-shot `mp edit` migration that writes a single commit per milestone, plus a `[manual-auto-prefix: <date>]` annotation on the verification field. The migration lives at `crates/mp/src/migrations/manual_prefix_backfill.rs` and is gated behind `mp migrate manual-prefix-backfill --yes`. Roll-out: dry-run first, then apply, then re-verify each affected milestone's complete path works without `--force`.

MP_VERIFY_NO_SHELL=1 default for legacy ACs: extend crates/mp/src/ac_verify.rs to read MP_VERIFY_DEFAULT_NO_SHELL=1 (new env var) — when set, every non-`manual:` verification auto-classifies as Manual regardless of the new prose detector. Document MP_VERIFY_DEFAULT_NO_SHELL in AGENT-READINESS.md as the canonical escape hatch for legacy plans. (MP_VERIFY_NO_SHELL=1 already exists and behaves identically at runtime; M177 adds the documentation and a softer default for the migration path.)

Regression test pin: every AC in M135 and M138 that was previously shell-parse-broken now classifies as Kind::Manual and the verification gate skips it. Add crates/mp/tests/verification_gate_prose_classify.rs covering M135 AC-02, M138 AC-03, M138 AC-05, and 5 random other milestones' ACs.
After each fix lands, update mp-dogfood-log.md Entry 21 + Entry 22 with `<!-- points-at: M177 -->` and a one-line status update.
out_of_scope: Reverting M135 or M138 to non-`--force` complete — both are already `lifecycle: complete`; the backfill is purely cosmetic on disk and the regression test is the gate that proves the pattern is fixed.
Re-running the bulk lifecycle migration (migrate_plan_lifecycle) — different migration; this is the manual-prefix backfill.
Touching ACs that already start with `manual: ` — they already classify correctly.
Adding a shell-safe verification parser (e.g. parse-and-validate with shlex) — too heavy for the gate; the prose detector is the lightweight fix.
Touching `mp plan verify-ac` — already non-mutating; this milestone is about the complete-gate classification, not the verify-ac integrity pre-flight.

acceptance_criteria.description: `mp edit strip-deferred-reason` clears stale `deferred_reason` text from milestone files where `deferred: false` (i.e. milestone was previously deferred, the deferral was lifted via `mp milestone set-status <id> in-progress` or `mp milestone reopen <id>`, but the rationale text was retained because no `mp` command existed to clear it without re-deferring). Idempotent: re-running is a no-op. Dry-run supported via `--dry-run` flag. Per-file atomic write via `crate::store::atomic_write`. Wrapped in `with_plan_write_lock` (M114 review F-1) so concurrent `mp milestone step add` cannot interleave.

findings.description: Write-time prose warn is JSON-only (no interactive y/n); matches agent-first CLI contract and M111 preflight pattern. Interactive confirm deferred.
findings.fixed_in: accepted-design: JSON-only prose_warning matches agent-first CLI

findings.description: Semicolon prose heuristic was quote-blind; real shell with quoted '; ' became Manual (silent pass). Fixed: quote-aware split_semicolon_clauses + M159 awk regression.
Semicolon allowlist missed !/export/VAR= prefixes. Fixed: transparent ! and VAR=value strip + export/unset/pushd/popd.
No CLI integration coverage for manual-prefix-backfill. Fixed: suites/manual_prefix_backfill.rs dry-run/yes/idempotent.
Dry-run files_modified semantics disagreed. Fixed: strip-deferred-reason files_modified=0 on dry-run.
Migration wrote via raw atomic_write. Fixed: store::write_milestone canonical path.

Pass-2 external: has_prose_parens walks every '(' regardless of single/double quotes, while split_semicolon_clauses is quote-aware (F-02). Empirical: cargo nextest run -E 'test(/foo-bar/)' classifies as Manual because inner '/foo-bar/' contains '-'. Also echo 'hello (world)' is Manual. Real plan ACs use nextest -E 'test(/.../)' extensively; hyphenated filter names (or any quoted paren with space/hyphen) silently skip shell execution (gate false-pass). Fix: quote-aware paren scan mirroring split_semicolon_clauses; drop bare '-' heuristic (documented prose cases all have spaces in the parenthetical).
findings.author: agent:external-reviewer
findings.summary: has_prose_parens is quote-blind; nextest -E filters with hyphens false-positive as Manual

findings.description: verification_gate_prose_classify_runnable_negatives pins cargo test/make/mp/subshell/rg/script but not the repo-canonical cargo nextest -E 'test(/name/)' form or quoted parentheses. Green suite missed the F-07 false-positive (L1). Fix: add negatives for nextest -E with hyphens, quoted parens, and keep unquoted prose parentheticals as Manual positives.
findings.author: agent:external-reviewer
findings.summary: Runnable negatives omit nextest -E filter and quoted-paren cases
